title: GTA 6 Release Date: Why Some Stores Show November 18
description: GTA 6 release date is November 19, 2026, but staggered midnight launches mean some players see November 18. Here's the timing, preload and PC details.

body.text: The GTA 6 release date is Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, but you may see November 18 on some store pages. According to Vice, Rockstar is using a staggered launch with a midnight unlock in each region, so the game goes live at different moments around the world. That matters if you're planning to be online the second it unlocks, or wondering why other players are already in Los Santos.
GTA 6 release date and regional launch times

Rockstar has confirmed midnight launches region by region, not one global moment. Vice explains that when it hits midnight on November 19 in New Zealand, it's still Wednesday morning in the U.S. That's why some players will be playing hours before others.

The U.S. PlayStation Store lists GTA 6 for 9 PM PT on Wednesday, November 18, which is the same moment as midnight Eastern on November 19. Vice's guide includes a regional table, but the part of the article we have doesn't give an India-specific time. Check your own store listing for the exact unlock.
Can the New Zealand trick work on Xbox?

Vice says the idea is to set your Xbox's location to New Zealand and see if your copy unlocks when the game goes live there. The method has reportedly worked for other staggered Xbox launches, and there's no public sign yet that Microsoft or Rockstar is blocking it.
It is still unconfirmed. Neither company has said it will work, and Vice notes we'll learn more when New Zealand's window opens at 3 AM PT / 6 AM ET on November 18.

On PS5, the trick is unlikely to help. Your PlayStation account's country is set when you create it, so changing the console's clock won't move a U.S. purchase into the New Zealand window, according to Vice.
Preload, physical copies and file size

items: Digital preorders can be preloaded on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Preloading opened on November 10.
If a physical copy arrives early, you can redeem the code inside and start downloading, but you still have to wait for your region's unlock.
Vice puts the file size at around 210 GB on both consoles, so clear space and download early.

body.text: GTA 6 PC release date: what's rumoured

Rockstar hasn't announced a PC date. The November 19 launch covers only PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Vice points to a GamesBeat report claiming Rockstar plans a PC release between January and March 2027, citing four sources familiar with the studio's plans.
That is not confirmed and should be treated as speculation until Rockstar says otherwise.

Keep an eye on your own store's countdown, since launch times differ by region and the store page is your most reliable guide. Also watch for any word from Microsoft or Rockstar on whether the Xbox location workaround holds up, and for an official PC announcement. Until then, finish your preload and free up the 210 GB.

faqs.a: According to Vice, the official release date is Thursday, November 19, 2026, on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, with Rockstar confirming a midnight release in each region.

faqs.a: Vice says digital preorders can be preloaded on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S, and preloading opened on November 10. The file size is around 210 GB on both consoles.

faqs.a: Rockstar hasn't announced one. GamesBeat reports, citing four sources, that a PC release could land between January and March 2027, but this is unconfirmed.
